s063.sec5.u0: Ugh... ngh... Meat... the fridge... key...
s063.sec5.u2: Oh... has someone... come to save me...?
s063.sec5.u4: Hah... I know not who you are... but food...
s063.sec5.u5: You're starving?! What do you want?
s063.sec5.u6: M... Meat... ugh... dripping... with blood...
s063.sec5.u8: Ugh... not that... Meat... dripping... with blood...
s063.sec5.u10: Meat...? Oh no, I don't have any on me.
s063.sec5.u13: Oops, I need to throw something out.
s063.sec5.u16: Whoa, I'd better hurry! I'll bring it right now, so hang in there a little longer!
s063.sec5.u18: Ahh, I feel alive again! Goodness, I put you to a lot of trouble. Forgive me.
s063.sec5.u19: What on earth happened to you?
s063.sec5.u20: Hm... Before that, allow me to introduce myself. I am Myotismon, master of this mansion. And you are?
s063.sec5.u21: I'm {color 6}{player}{color 1}, a human from the outside world. This is my partner, {color 10}{partner}{color 1}. We're on a journey to save this island.
s063.sec5.u22: Oh ho! It seems we have much to discuss. I ought to welcome you properly, with a banquet. Follow me.
s063.sec60.u3: It vanished... Was it an illusion...?
s063.sec60.u4: Looks like we beat it... somehow.
s063.sec60.u7: I sort of blacked out all of a sudden... Oh! S-sorry about that!
s063.sec60.u8: Hmmmm?? What was that? The curse of Analogman?! Oh well, it should be fine now.
